findings.summary: validateSliceCorrection/activeSlice unbound slice_id allows validating a non-active ready slice
findings.acceptance_criteria: Validation MUST bind exclusively to active_slice_id and pending_correction.slice_id; diverting to another ready slice MUST throw; covered by multi-slice regression test.

findings.summary: createSuccessor authority_kind only enforced for remediation-v2 predecessors
findings.acceptance_criteria: createSuccessor MUST require allowlisted authority_kind for all post-rollout successors or reject non-v2 predecessors; terminate-v1 then untyped successor MUST fail closed in tests.

findings.summary: beginSliceCorrection accepts any ready slice_id, not only reducer-selected
findings.acceptance_criteria: beginSliceCorrection MUST accept only the reducer-selected ready slice_id; out-of-order ready slices MUST be rejected with a test.

findings.summary: v2 applyTargetedValidation/validateSliceCorrection weaker than v1 on outcomes and regression.evidence
findings.acceptance_criteria: Parity fail-closed with v1/design for outcomes and regression; reject detected:true without impacts; explicit tests for each unhappy path

findings.summary: migrateReviewLineage does not fail closed on legacy regression.detected without attributable impacts
findings.acceptance_criteria: Fail-closed on migration + negative fixture; O4.2 with detected:false remains valid

findings.summary: slice.resolutions can diverge from status after validation
findings.acceptance_criteria: Sync resolutions on pass/fail/reopen; invariant in assertRemediationV2; named test

findings.summary: freezeFindings does not attach remediation-v2 by default
findings.acceptance_criteria: Auto-attach v2 on freeze or tested explicit migration-required deferral contract

findings.summary: validateSliceCorrection fail-open on omitted regression or detected:true without attributable impacted_slices
findings.acceptance_criteria: Require regression with detected and non-empty evidence; detected:true without attributable impacted_slices must throw; no passed/approved with unattributed regression

findings.summary: beginSliceCorrection lacks exact-retry idempotency
findings.acceptance_criteria: Same request_id and exact pending state while correcting returns clone(state); divergence throws

findings.summary: slice.resolutions stale after validate/reopen
findings.acceptance_criteria: Sync slice.resolutions with findings; integrity fails on divergence

findings.summary: Go persistResultEnvelope missing orphan .bak recovery vs JS
findings.acceptance_criteria: Parity with JS orphan bak recovery under lock before read

findings.summary: remediation-v2 slice state-machine packed into unauditable single-line transitions
findings.acceptance_criteria: Expand four functions to one statement per line with named helpers for active-slice load, impacted reopen, and terminal transition

findings.summary: committed v2 reconciliation authority is a monolithic unnamed predicate
findings.acceptance_criteria: Named asserts/predicates documenting immutable vs advanceable fields

findings.summary: design.md slice budget/status shape diverges from reducer
findings.acceptance_criteria: Single canonical shape/enum in design and reducer, or explicit conceptual disclaimer

findings.summary: attachRemediationV2 legacy seeding nesting/priority opaque
findings.acceptance_criteria: Extract seedSliceFromLegacyValidations with authority-order comment; nesting <= 3

findings.acceptance_criteria: Named constant or one-line comment fixing intentional deterministic value
